title: Colombo National Museum — Polonnaruwa hospital and sanitation panel
author_or_institution: Colombo National Museum / Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
scope: Alahana Parivena hospital, medical instruments, sanitation, Parakramabahu and physicians
limitations: Museum synthesis combines archaeological material and chronicle quotation; royal medical competence remains partly a literary representation.

title: Ancient Monastic Hospital System in Sri Lanka
scope: Archaeology and organisation of ancient Sri Lankan monastic hospitals including Alahana Parivena
limitations: Synthetic heritage article; individual artefact identifications still depend on archaeological publication.

title: Vijayanagara c. 1350–1564
scope: Vijayanagara political economy, nayaka system and relations between political reorganisation and economic order
limitations: Macro-regional synthesis; does not by itself establish specific Sri Lankan vassalage episodes.

title: The Maritime Trade of India
scope: Continuity and change in Indian Ocean maritime trade in the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries
limitations: Broad Indian Ocean synthesis; local Sri Lankan mechanisms require site- or polity-specific evidence.

title: The Political Economy of Commerce: Southern India 1500–1650
scope: Ports, external trade, fiscal regimes and the strategic value of imported horses, weapons and mobile expertise in southern India
limitations: Main chronological focus begins around 1500; used as structural comparator rather than direct proof for all fourteenth-century episodes.
